newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon reiterates buy on Best Buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon reiterates buy on Best Buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers Inc Thursday reiterated its buy rating for Best Buy Co Inc, with a six-to-nine-month price target in the mid-teens.

-- Analyst David Childe said in a report the "seemingly washed out stock" could be poised for upward move. Childe cited the retailer's significant positive surprise on comparable store sales last month, improving retail industry fundamentals and a recent increase in Salomon's calendar 1997 estimate to $0.50 a share from $0.45.
-- Childe also cited a reasonably significant open market stock purchase recently by Best Buy Chairman Richard Schulze.
-- Bust Buy shares were up 1-1/2 Thursday at 12-3/8.

-- Childe estimated a loss of $0.15 for fiscal 1997, which ended February 28. He also clarified that the estimated net income of $0.50 a share for calendar 1997 is the estimate for Best Buy's fiscal year ending in February 1998.
